name: git-chip
title: Git Chip
description: Inline chips for git names in text: GitFileChip (a file icon and the path in mono) and GitBranchChip (a branch icon and the name).
docs: `<GitFileChip path="src/routes.ts" />` and `<GitBranchChip name="main" />` sit inline in a sentence, like a commit message: quiet tokens in caption mono, no taller than the line, with a size-3 icon and muted text on a translucent fill that shows on a hovered or selected row as on the card (an outline appears only in forced-colors mode). `textRef` renders the name empty for a virtualizer's `findableText`. Both take `render` and any span prop.
